title: legal-empirics: measuring which drafting language gets litigated
description:
Empirical preventive law: measuring which drafting formulations draw litigation and which survive it, over a local corpus of 10.8M US judicial opinions joined to versioned state statutes.

This record archives the code, methodology and classifiers. The datasets they produce are deposited separately and linked by related identifier, because a dataset that is cited as a dataset needs its own DOI.

Methodology is deterministic where it can be and validated where it cannot: classifiers ship with measured precision and recall, every study reports its exclusion funnel with counts, and findings are reported as three numbers (exposure, risk, vindication) rather than one.
